types.name: Collectible Cards
types.desc: Trading cards in 18 themed sets, picked up around Leonida.
how: There are **480 cards** split over **18 sets**, from sports teams to dancers and comics.
Cards are lying around indoors and out. Pick one up and it goes into your collection.
Finishing the **Vice City Flamingos** set (24 cards) unlocks the **Bubblegum** cheat.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.

types.name: WAiNK Locations
types.desc: Landmarks, sculptures and oddities you scan with the WAiNK app on your phone.
how: Open WAiNK on your phone, point it at the spot and scan.
Scans come in four kinds: **landmarks**, **sculptures**, **curiosities** and **utility markings**.
The same app scans cars (for the vehicle count) and posters (for the unique playlists).
Track them under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.

types.name: Cocaine Flamingos
types.desc: Pink flamingo ornaments with cocaine hidden inside. Shoot them.
how: Shoot a flamingo and it drops a parcel of cocaine.
The cocaine is worth money: sell it to a [fence](/guides/activities-and-collectibles/#fences). It also counts toward the $100,000 of narcotics the 100% checklist wants.
Destroying 50 unlocks the **Inflatable Flamingo** spawn cheat.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Cocaine Flamingos.

types.name: Meditation Spots
types.desc: Quiet places to sit and meditate, spread over 10 locations.
how: There are **18 spots** at **10 locations**, so several locations have more than one.
Jason and Lucia can both meditate at the same spot. Bring your partner along.
The trophy needs all 18, the 100% checklist only 15.
Fifty meditations unlock the **Fast Forward** cheat.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
types.note: Unconfirmed, but worth knowing: Lucia offers a meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after [Down to Earth](/walkthrough/down-to-earth/). It may count toward the trophy, and it can't be done once Chapter 2 starts. Accept it if she asks.

types.name: Underwater Discoveries
types.desc: Wrecks and other sights on the sea floor.
how: Diving opens with Kenton in [Island Dreams](/walkthrough/island-dreams/) in Chapter 1. Discoveries include wrecks and other sights under water.
The 100% checklist wants every one of them.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Underwater Discoveries.

types.name: Magazines, Books and Comics
types.desc: Reading material left around the state, including book swaps.
how: Only different titles count. Picking up the same one twice doesn't help.
Book swaps count too.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration.

types.name: Discovered Styles
types.desc: Tattoo designs from magazines, and luxury watches.
how: Styles come in four groups: Jason's magazine tattoos, Lucia's magazine tattoos, shared magazine tattoos and luxury watches.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Discovered Styles.

types.name: Unique Playlists
types.desc: Two music playlists you unlock by scanning posters.
how: Scan the right posters with WAiNK to add a playlist.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Unique Playlists.
